Hi Lisa / Acme security team —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to get the mutual action plan (MAP) started and introduce the folks on both sides who will own security/compliance items so we can agree responsibilities and a short close timeline. Our goal is to have an initial evidence inventory and kickoff complete next week so we can keep the evaluation on track for July close.

Redwood contacts (internal):
- Soojin Lee — Account Lead (soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com) — overall MAP owner / timeline coordination
- Vivek Kulkarni — Head of Security & Compliance — technical SOC2 evidence and controls lead
- Monica Patel — Solutions Engineer — will coordinate evidence collection and demo requests

Suggested Acme contacts (please confirm or update):
- Lisa Garcia — GRC / primary SOC 2 POC
- Marcel Diaz — Infra / evidence owner for cloud configs
- security@acmeinc.com — security team alias (for artifact uploads)

Proposed next steps / dates (feel free to adjust):
1) Confirm POCs and evidence drop location by EOD Tue, 2026-05-25
2) Kickoff call (30m) — Mon, 2026-05-24 10:00 AM PT / 13:00 ET — Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/rwi-acme-kickoff
3) Evidence inventory (initial list of artifacts) due Fri, 2026-05-28
4) Redwood to share MAP template / evidence request (attached) — Mon, 2026-05-21

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (short checklist), RWI_MAP_Acme_v0.2.xlsx (MAP template placeholder)

Questions for you now: can you confirm the three POCs above and whether Acme prefers a shared S3 folder or secure file upload to our intake endpoint? Also flag any embargoed artifacts that require special handling.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the note and the clear plan. Confirming POCs:
- Lisa Garcia (me) — GRC / SOC 2 POC
- Marcel Diaz — cloud infra lead & evidence owner (marcel.diaz@acmeinc.com)
- security@acmeinc.com — ops alias for artifact uploads

We'll plan to use our secure ShareFile folder for document transfers (we'll send invite to your team). I attached our most recent SOC2 report (redacted) to speed the initial review. For the kickoff call on 5/24 10am PT, Marcel and I can make it — can Vivek and Monica join?

One quick technical question up front: can you confirm whether Redwood will need proof of encryption-at-rest for our managed DBs or if an attestation from our cloud provider plus config screenshots is acceptable? We'll flag anything that's not shareable due to customer privacy.

Attaching: SOC2-Acme-2024-summary.pdf

Best,

Subject: Re: MAP: Security & Compliance POC intro + timeline (Acme)

Hi Lisa — thanks for confirming. Yes, Monica and I will join the kickoff; Vivek here — quick answer on encryption: a combination is fine. For managed DBs we accept a cloud provider attestation plus a screenshot of the KMS key policy and bucket encryption settings; we only need deep artifact downloads for a very small subset (e.g., rotation proofs) that are typically redacted. If anything has stricter contractual restrictions, let us know and we can treat it as an "attestation-only" item in the MAP.

Marissa — looping you in for contract-side questions (timeline / procurement).

See you on 5/24.

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
